text: Okay, so looking at these 20 plots, the one that looks the most different to me would be number 19. It has a much larger spread for the blue points data than all the other ones and it's also in a slightly different placement than the others, a little more to the right. And then the bottom, the red rectangle or the red plot points seems to be smaller, so less concentration than all the others at the beginning toward the left. So number 19 to me looks the most different.
